answer: Give every new agent a small island cohort: it may only trade after a lightweight sparrow peer vouches for it, and that vouch is a whisper — a signed, private attestation that locks the voucher stake. A Sybil farmer must buy a separate stake and an honest vouch for each clone, so 100 clones cost 100 stakes plus 100 vouches, while an honest agent pays once and keeps trading. A clone that misbehaves burns its voucher stake too.
